changes: Shared annual/recent tool groups; removed unused original-question forwarding and redundant prompt lines.
One bounded retry for empty specialist output, verified with mocked first-empty/second-success and repeated-empty cases.
Critic accepts supported qualitative comparisons when user has not requested exact amounts; deterministic number validation retained.
limitations: Only failed cases were rerun after fixes; not five successful first attempts or a full same-version rerun.
Specialists can still receive redundant fiscal-year tasks and attempt invalid fiscal_year concepts.
Some supplemental numeric figures can only be summarized qualitatively until structured extraction is available.
Small acceptance set does not establish universal reliability or production readiness.
Repeated empty outputs still fail after one retry; no indefinite retries.
